placementEvaluation.notes: The learner meets the task requirements: they produce a nuanced position (innovation ≠ only disruption), use an advanced connector naturally (连...都 / 更不用说), and they engage substantively with the counterargument by acknowledging the merits of radical change while pointing out its risks.
